recent_experiments.name: Stochastic Trajectory Alignment via Local Energy Gradients #11
recent_experiments.principle: Approximates the loss gradient by performing a single forward pass with a small random perturbation to the input activations, then computing the dot product between this perturbation and the change in the final energy state, leveraging the linearity of the first-order Taylor expansion to estimate directional derivatives without chain-rule backpropagation.

recent_experiments.name: Orthogonal Feedback Alignment with Tangential Hebbian Contrast #4
recent_experiments.principle:
By combining orthogonal feedback alignment and tangential Hebbian contrast, this algorithm updates weights without relying on backpropagation.
The orthogonal feedback alignment helps align the gradients (directional finite differences) with the target weights, while tangential Hebbian contrast encourages the weights to minimize a tangential contrastive divergence objective.

recent_experiments.name: Random Feedback Alignment with Finite Difference (RFAD)
recent_experiments.principle: A random feedback matrix projects the output error onto each hidden layer, and finite‐difference perturbations of each weight estimate the local directional derivative of the loss; combining these yields a local weight update that monotonically decreases the loss without exact backpropagation.
